[[General/Legends|General]] '''Shri-Lan''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as the "Left Fist" of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Hadiya]] during the [[Despot War]]. After the defeat of the [[Despot Army]] at the [[Battle of Tython]], Shri-Lan was banished from her homeworld of [[Shikaakwa]] and [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] on [[Nox (planet)|Nox]] with the other Generals of Hadiya's Inner Circle.
